name: Martin Luther
bio:
Augustinian friar and professor of Scripture at Wittenberg whose Ninety-five Theses (1517) began the Reformation; excommunicated in 1521, he translated the Bible into German and shaped the Lutheran churches.

His commentary on Galatians, from lectures given in 1531 and published in 1535, sets out his teaching that a sinner is justified by faith in Christ alone, and was the book of his he valued most.
